title: cyclosorus loherianus
intro: Cyclosorus loherianus, commonly known as the Loher's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae, native to the Philippines. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cyclosorus loherianus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are also thought to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
